column1: # Guitar Chords library for Flipper Zero
#   NAME       displayed name; leading letter (+ # or b) becomes the root
#   FRETS      exactly 6 chars, low E first.
#              x = muted, 0 = open, 1-9 = frets above BASE_FRET
#   BASE_FRET  fret the diagram starts on. 1 = at the nut. Optional, default 1
#   FINGERS    exactly 6 chars, - = none, 1-4 = finger. Optional.
#              Repeating the same finger across strings on one fret draws a barre
# Reusing a NAME adds another voicing of that chord rather than replacing it.
# Left/Right cycles them in the order they appear here, so keep open positions
# first. Frets must stay within 4 of BASE_FRET or the dot is not drawn.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Edit freely - no rebuild needed, just restart the app.
